claims: As of April 2026, John Ternus is the incoming CEO of Apple.

John Ternus oversees hardware engineering for iPad, AirPods, iPhone, Mac.

John Ternus joined Apple's executive team in 2021 as Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering.

John Ternus is described as having a "careful, low-profile style."
